HeySummon Provider Skill v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides setup and usage instructions for integrating as a human-help provider on HeySummon.
- Documents required environment variables and validation for provider API keys.
- Details event watcher startup/teardown scripts for handling request notifications and replies.
- Explains the architecture and communication flow between AI agent, platform, and provider.
- Outlines reply flow and status codes for handling user requests efficiently.
